turnover_convention: One-way turnover = 0.5 * sum(abs(target_weights - previous_actual_weights)); first investment from cash has zero turnover.
holding_period_convention: Weekly target weights with daily holdings drift and no rebalancing within the week.
transaction_cost_convention: Rebalance cost deducted from capital at the start of each holding period.
initial_capital_convention: Initial portfolio starts as cash; the first model allocation is the initial investment.
